decisions.reason: The Air Quality Bricklet had its own page in consecutive years and fits the growing demand for environmental sensing, so it appears to meet aspirations and fits the modular platform at little carrying cost.

As the current generation of a long-standing core measurement module that replaced its predecessor, the Analog In Bricklet 3.0 is part of the established portfolio and gives no shortfall signal to trigger search.

The CAN interface serves industrial and automation customers within the building-block system, and its modest maintenance costs, shared with the firmware and API infrastructure, make keeping it reasonable despite less visible promotion.
The CO2 sensor module had sustained dedicated presentation and benefits from strong interest in indoor CO2 monitoring, suggesting satisfactory performance relative to aspirations.
